awareness: Low — Customers know they owe money but do not know a digital payment portal exists (SN-017).
desire: High (~40%) — Strong desire among digitally capable customers to resolve debt discreetly (SN-001, SN-099).
knowledge: Medium — Customers are familiar with general online banking but need intuitive guidance to select 3–6 month payment plans.
ability: High — High ability if the portal interface is simple, mobile-friendly, and requires minimal steps.
reinforcement: Medium — Need immediate SMS/email confirmations to trust the arrangement is logged (SN-002).
key_risk: Low Portal Adoption: Customers continue calling phone lines due to lack of portal awareness (SN-017).
mitigation_action: Embed portal links and QR codes into all SMS, email, and IVR collections notices.
delivery_implication: Scope Requirement: Build automated SMS/email receipt and confirmation engines into Phase 1.

awareness: High — Fully aware of current process failures, spreadsheet bloat (SN-025), and fragmented trails (SN-008).
desire: Medium-Low — Want better tools (SN-034) but fear job loss (SN-097) or being flooded with broken portal hand-offs (SN-108).
knowledge: Low-Medium — Need training on how the portal triages work and how routed cases appear in their queues.
ability: High — Highly skilled with creative domain workarounds (SN-013); ability rises once system friction is removed.
reinforcement: High — Need to see that the portal genuinely reduces admin without changing performance KPIs.
key_risk: Portal Rejection & Bypassing: Reps reject routed cases that lack context (SN-108) or fear job replacement (SN-097).
mitigation_action: Frame portal as an Admin Shield and enforce mandatory context-rich payload attachments on all routed cases.
delivery_implication: Scope Requirement: Story RTE-02 must attach session logs, pages viewed, and exit codes to rep tickets.

awareness: High — High awareness of queue entanglement (SN-029), lost shift hand-offs (SN-040), and broken reporting (SN-012).
desire: High — Eager to eliminate manual reconciliation and regain visibility over true pipeline status.
knowledge: Medium — Need full understanding of automated triage rules, hardship gateways, and SLA metrics.
ability: Medium — Constrained by legacy reporting limits; ability depends on new real-time operational dashboards.
reinforcement: High — Require auditable, real-time reporting to verify capacity savings and recovery metrics to Finance (SN-031).
key_risk: Operational Instability & Bypassed Rules: Managers fear a complex or brittle portal will create more work for teams (SN-004).
mitigation_action: Establish explicit triage rules and hardship exit gates to keep complex cases strictly human-led.
delivery_implication: Scope Requirement: Build automated queue triage (OP-04) and real-time operational reporting dashboards (REP-02) into Phase 1.
